name: Francis Joseph Costello
role: Tenure-Track Assistant Professor of Management Information Systems
university: Nova School of Business and Economics
bio: I currently serve as a tenure-track Assistant Professor of Management Information Systems in the Technology Group within the Department of Operations, Technology and Innovation Management (OTIM) at NOVA School of Business and Economics.

My research examines digital intermediation and how technology platforms shape markets, organizations, and decision-making. My work spans artificial intelligence, open innovation, entrepreneurial information systems, platform subscriptions, and human-AI collaboration, using causal inference, behavioral experiments, and computational methods. My research has appeared in Management Science, Decision Support Systems, and the Journal of Business Research, among other outlets.
